feedback: Accept a correct group placement, and when the learner has placed it, prompt 'what does it eat?' so the food-based reason is spoken as well as the group named.
Include a gorilla or hippo card so a fierce-appearance error can be surfaced and corrected with its actual plant diet.
activities.intendedInsight: Classifying is a justified decision: each animal belongs in a group because of the food it eats, and that reason can be stated out loud.
learnerActions: Lay out picture cards of at least six familiar animals and three labelled hoops or trays: herbivore, carnivore, omnivore.
Match each animal to a 'what it eats' card (rabbit–grass, lion–meat, bear–berries+fish) and place it in the matching group.
Say a spoken reason for each decision based on the food, e.g. 'the bear is an omnivore because it eats berries and fish'.
activities.title: Sort real picture cards in class
